answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow ties each identity to a work history. A new agent locks 20 POA and must show 30 days of work: tasks, varied counterparties, stable timing, like a sparrow returning to one grove. Forged histories are rejected. An attacker making 1000 fakes must lock 1000x20=20000 POA and forge 1000 histories, each as hard as a cave system in karst rock, while an honest agent pays one 20 POA deposit, with a sable seal and gets it back.
